skills.skill: Multiply and divide whole and decimal numbers by powers of ten

misconceptions.pattern: Shifts the decimal point the wrong way or the wrong number of places (answers 3.5 × 100 as 0.035 or 35 instead of 350).

strategies.intent: The power of ten tells you how many places to move the decimal point: multiplying moves it right (the number gets bigger), dividing moves it left (the number gets smaller). Move one place per zero.
